SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 , SHKOZE
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e kater te nje objekti te ndertuar vitet e fundit, te mireadministruar me ashensor.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 70.4 m2 bruto dhe 62.9m2 neto, perbehet nga nje korridor shperndares, dhome ndenje me ambient gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Apartamenti shitet I pa mobiluar, ka lokacion te favorshem , ndodhet ne nje zone te qete banimi, shume afer autostrades, zones se Freskut dhe parkut te Dajtit.
Mundesi shume e mire per banim dhe investim.
Per me shume informacion dhe vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE, SHKOZE The apartment is located on the fourth floor of a building built in recent years, well managed with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​70.4 m2 gross and 62.9 m2 net, it consists of a corridor, living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The apartment is sold unfurnished, it has a favorable location, it is located in a quiet residential area, very close to the highway, the Fresk area and the Dajti park. Very good opportunity for housing and investment. For more information and a visit to the property, contact me!
